items.stem: Which is a primary legitimate motivation for using synthetic data?

options.text: Sharing data-like examples without exposing real personal records
options.rationale: Correct: privacy preservation is a core synthetic-data use case.

options.text: Guaranteeing the model will never be wrong
options.rationale: Synthetic data does not guarantee correctness.

options.text: Removing the need to evaluate the model

options.rationale: Synthetic data can amplify bias, not remove it.

items.stem: Which TWO checks belong in synthetic-data quality assurance? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Comparing real and synthetic distributions for fidelity
options.rationale: Correct: fidelity checks that synthetic data resembles real patterns.

options.text: Testing whether real records were memorized and reproduced
Confirming the data file is larger than the original
options.rationale: File size is not a quality measure.

options.text: Checking that it looks realistic and ignoring utility
options.rationale: Utility for the downstream task also matters.

items.explanation: Correct: fidelity checks that synthetic data resembles real patterns.

options.text: Generators learn and can exaggerate patterns, including biased ones, in the source
options.rationale: Correct: models reproduce and may intensify source biases.
It can carry and amplify bias.
Documentation records provenance; it does not cause bias.
